ACME ENGINEERING — Kadro Workforce Management (version 2.5.2)
==============================================================

UPDATING — IF YOU ALREADY USE KADRO
  Your records are NOT inside KADRO.exe; they are in this folder on your computer:  Documents\KADRO
  So replacing the program is all you need to do; the records and documents you entered stay as they are.

  1. Close the black Kadro window if it is open.
  2. Delete the old KADRO.exe and put this new KADRO.exe in the same place (e.g. the Desktop).
  3. Double-click the new KADRO.exe. Your records open.

  On first start the new version takes a backup of your records by itself (Documents\KADRO\data\backups).
  For extra peace of mind, BEFORE updating, in the old program: Settings → "Download backup". Keep the .json file.

MOVING TO ANOTHER COMPUTER
  On the old computer: Settings → "Download backup" → take the .json file to the new computer by USB or e-mail.
  On the new computer: open KADRO.exe → Settings → "Restore from backup…" → choose that file.
  Note: the backup file carries the records. Uploaded documents (PDFs, photos) are in the Documents\KADRO folder;
  for those, copy this folder as it is into the Documents folder of the new computer.

FIRST-TIME SETUP
  Double-click KADRO.exe. Nothing to install. The program opens empty; you start by entering your records.

OPENING
  Double-click KADRO.exe.
  A black window opens and the program starts in the browser.
  Do NOT close the black window while you use the program; close it when you are done.

  If Windows warns about an "unknown publisher": "More info" → "Run anyway".

NEW (2.5)
  "Employment Periods" on the employee page: the dates and project a person works on are recorded like a contract.
  The leaving date can be entered in advance; the status (Active / On leave / Left) changes by itself according to these dates.
  Long leave is entered with the "Leave" type. Days outside the period are hatched in the timesheet and are not counted.
  "Employee's view": choose at most two periods or a day-by-day date range. "Print / PDF" prints the timesheet, the earnings
  calculation and that month's meal allowance payments (salary payments, pay and house details are not in the PDF).
  "Notes" on the person page: each note is saved under its own title and can be edited or deleted. The old note field moved to "General note".
  Notes never appear on the printout given to the employee or in voice commands.
  An "Insurance Start" date was added to the employee record.

NEW (2.4) — VOICE COMMANDS
  The orange microphone button at the bottom right of every page. Tap the microphone and speak, tap again when done. Examples:
    "Cem was absent today, Tolga worked 10 hours" · "I gave Mehmet a 100 euro advance" · "I bought 60 euro of fuel"
    "Cem's hourly wages for the 2nd half of September are paid" · "How much will Murat get this month?" · "Who was absent today?"
  Nothing is written until you press "Approve". Every action can be undone from "Recent actions" in the panel.
  Voice commands come ready to use; there is nothing to set up.
  An internet connection is needed. The audio and the sentence go to the assistant server; IBANs, phone numbers, passports and notes do not.
  To improve the assistant, the spoken command, the action taken and its outcome are logged on the server (audio is not stored).

NEW (2.3)
  "Employee's view" on the employee page: the employee's own timesheet, earnings, reasons for deductions and payments.
  It can be printed with "Print / PDF" and sent to the employee.
  A document uploaded by mistake is removed with "Delete" in the Folder Tree (it goes to the _Deleted folder first and can be restored).
  Settings → "Reset records": delete test records and start clean. A backup is taken automatically first.

NEW (2.2)
  Settings → "Currency and rates": the base currency (EUR) and the rates are entered by hand (1 EUR = 117 RSD, 1 EUR = … TRY).
  In timesheets, meals, rent and advances in another currency are converted at these rates and deducted from pay.
  Click a deduction figure to see the calculation item by item (daily salary + rent share + meals).
  Note: rates apply to newly opened timesheet periods. For an open period there is a "Move to the new rules" button in the panel.

NEW (2.1)
  Payments page: salaries, meal allowances and rents are listed person by person; ticking "paid" puts them in the cash book.
  The amount paid can be changed by hand. Overtime rates are entered per currency in the timesheet side panel.

TIP
  Extract KADRO.exe to the Desktop and open it from there rather than from inside the zip file.
